preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output must be present in the input string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(c for c in s if s.count(c) > 1)
postconditions.description: The output must contain only characters that appear more than once in the input string.
